missing: Independent tests of real-world performance: measured round-trip efficiency, whether the battery holds up under surge loads like central AC and well pumps, how long backup lasts during outages, and long-term reliability. None of the sources come from a major reviewer or Consumer Reports.
why: Several substantive niche sources (EnergySage, Solar.com, and installers) answer the question with specs and installed prices, and they agree on Powerwall 3, aPower 2 and Enphase. However, no major reviewer or authority source is present, and most of the rest are untested affiliate listicles. Some of those listicles have outdated tax credit information.
